other_failure_modes.name: Dropping high-cardinality categoricals
other_failure_modes.description: The agent automatically drops string/object columns with more than 50 unique values if they cannot be converted to numeric. This can discard highly informative features in a global database (e.g., country, river name, or region).

other_failure_modes.name: No hyperparameter tuning
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses fixed, hardcoded hyperparameters for the XGBoost model without performing any search to optimize them for the specific dataset.

summary: The agent implements a solid, leak-free pipeline using XGBoost with native categorical support and K-Fold cross-validation. However, it lacks any feature engineering, uses fixed hyperparameters without tuning, and drops high-cardinality categorical features entirely, which likely degrades predictive performance.
